blocks.heading: A two-tier program built for **Claude adoption**
blocks.body: The Foundation session gives your pilot group the habits and confidence to use Claude effectively. After the team applies the learning to real work, the Advanced session turns the most valuable opportunities into skills, prototypes and a practical implementation plan.

accordionItems.label: Foundation — What Claude Is and Where It Fits
accordionItems.content:
Understand what Claude is good at, where it is limited and where human judgement is still required.

Your team learns the principles for using Claude safely, responsibly and effectively in day-to-day business work.

accordionItems.label: Foundation — Chat, Cowork and Code
accordionItems.content:
Learn when the conversation itself is the work, when to hand Claude a task and when Claude Code is the right tool for a software team.

Participants leave with a clear mental model for choosing the appropriate Claude mode for each job.

accordionItems.label: Foundation — Prompting and Everyday Work
accordionItems.content:
Practise giving Claude clear goals, context, constraints and examples.

Your team applies these techniques to relevant finance, operations and everyday business tasks rather than working through generic demonstrations.

accordionItems.label: Foundation — Applied Workflow Scenarios
accordionItems.content:
Work through practical scenarios based on relevant real-world workflows.

The session finishes with questions, useful tips and clear next steps for what the pilot group should test and share internally.

accordionItems.label: Advanced — Using Claude Code
accordionItems.content: Starting using Claude Code and vibing up solutions - get comfortable with the processes and best practice in getting the results you want.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer:
Foundation Training is $5,200 + GST.

Advanced Training is $5,200 + GST.

The total for both tiers is $10,400 + GST.

Each fee includes a half-day onsite session and dedicated preparation. Advanced Training is delivered by two SSW presenters. Any additional consulting, development or implementation work can be scoped separately.

faqs.question: Do attendees need to know how to code?
faqs.answer: No coding experience is required for Foundation Training. The Foundation session is designed for a mixed business audience and is suitable for finance, operations, leadership and technical team members. Claude Code is introduced so the group understands where it fits, but Foundation Training is not a software development course.

faqs.question: How long is the training?
faqs.answer:
Each training tier is delivered as a separate half-day onsite session.

The proposed Foundation session runs from 1:30 pm to 5:00 pm, including a 30-minute break from 3:00 pm to 3:30 pm. This provides three hours of delivery.

Advanced Training is another half-day session, scheduled after the pilot group has applied the Foundation learning and completed a planning check-in with SSW.

faqs.question: Who should attend?
faqs.answer:
Foundation Training is for pilot groups and people who are new to Claude or are still developing consistent working habits.

It is suitable for business, finance, operations and relevant technical team members.

Advanced Training is for experienced users who have already applied Claude to real work and can bring specific bottlenecks, workflows or solution ideas into the room.

The appropriate group size is confirmed during planning so participants receive useful support during the hands-on exercises.

faqs.question: What will our team take away?
faqs.answer:
After Foundation Training, your team will have a shared understanding of Chat, Cowork and Code, practical prompting techniques, safe-use principles and a focused list of workflows to test.

After Advanced Training, your team may leave with custom Claude skills, working prototypes, documented use cases and clearer options for automation, integration, architecture and further implementation.
